name: Heartland Ridge Care Center
priceNote: Nebraska average for a nursing home (semi-private to private room). This facility does not publish its price.

inspections.title: Food stored or prepared unsafely
inspections.detail: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

inspections.title: Infection control not followed
inspections.detail: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

inspections.title: Equipment not kept in safe working order
inspections.detail: Keep all essential equipment working safely.

inspections.title: Transfer / bed-hold notice not given
inspections.detail: Provide the required documentation or notification related to the resident's needs, appeal rights, or bed-hold policies.

inspections.title: Resident assessment inaccurate
inspections.detail: Ensure each resident receives an accurate assessment.

inspections.title: Breathing / oxygen care problems
inspections.detail: Provide safe and appropriate respiratory care for a resident when needed.

inspections.title: Dialysis care problems
inspections.detail: Provide safe, appropriate dialysis care/services for a resident who requires such services.

inspections.title: Medication error rate of 5% or more
inspections.detail: Ensure medication error rates are not 5 percent or greater.

inspections.title: Staff lacked required skills
inspections.detail: Ensure that nurses and nurse aides have the appropriate competencies to care for every resident in a way that maximizes each resident's well being.

inspections.title: Kitchen not properly staffed
inspections.detail: Employ sufficient staff with the appropriate competencies and skills sets to carry out the functions of the food and nutrition service, including a qualified dietician.

inspections.title: Food stored or prepared unsafely
inspections.detail: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

inspections.title: Nurse aides missing required dementia and abuse training
inspections.detail: Ensure nurse aides have the skills they need to care for residents, and give nurse aides education in dementia care and abuse prevention.

inspections.title: Discharge notice not given
inspections.detail: Provide timely notification to the resident, and if applicable to the resident representative and ombudsman, before transfer or discharge, including appeal rights.

inspections.title: Bed-hold policy not explained
inspections.detail: Notify the resident or the resident’s representative in writing how long the nursing home will hold the resident’s bed in cases of transfer to a hospital or therapeutic leave.

inspections.title: COVID-19 vaccine education not done
inspections.detail: Educate residents and staff on COVID-19 vaccination, offer the COVID-19 vaccine to eligible residents and staff after education, and properly document each resident and staff member's vaccination status.

inspections.title: Family or doctor not told about a change or injury
inspections.detail: Immediately tell the resident, the resident's doctor, and a family member of situations (injury/decline/room, etc.)  that affect the resident.

inspections.title: Suspected abuse or neglect not reported on time
inspections.detail: Timely report suspected abuse, neglect, or theft and report the results of the investigation to proper authorities.
inspections.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation

inspections.title: Improper transfer or discharge
inspections.detail: Not transfer or discharge a resident without an adequate reason; and must provide documentation and convey specific information  when a resident is transferred or discharged.

inspections.title: Food stored or prepared unsafely
inspections.detail: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

inspections.title: Care not given as ordered
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

inspections.title: Unnecessary medications given
inspections.detail: Ensure each resident’s drug regimen must be free from unnecessary drugs.

quality.label: Needing more help with daily activities

openings.note: Estimate: certified beds minus average daily residents (CMS). Certified beds are often more than the beds actually staffed. Call to confirm.

bio: For-profit nursing home in Lincoln with 47 certified beds. Provides 24-hour skilled nursing care, long-term care, and short-term rehab. Aging Partners lists this facility for Medicare short stays only. Ask whether it takes long-term residents.
sources: Medicare / CMS Provider Data: provider info, health inspections, penalties, ownership, quality measures (processed 2026-10-01)
Dementia units & VA contracts: City of Lincoln Aging Partners nursing facility list (Mar 2024); Eastern Nebraska Office on Aging facility list (Sep 2025)
Price: CareScout Cost of Care Survey 2024, Nebraska averages
